class.name: Console
class.brief_description: An in-game console that runs commands the game adds.
class.description:
The console opens with the key set in [code]console/open_key[/code] (backquote, under Escape, by default) and closes with it or Escape. It shows what the game prints, its warnings and errors, and runs commands added with [method add_command]: [codeblock] func _ready(): Console.add_command("teleport", teleport, "Moves the player to a point.")
func teleport(where: Vector3, height := 0.0): player.global_position = where + Vector3.UP * height [/codeblock] Typed in, [code]teleport 10,0,-4[/code] calls [code]teleport(Vector3(10, 0, -4))[/code]. Arguments are converted to the types the method declares: numbers, [code]true[/code] or [code]false[/code] (or [code]on[/code] and [code]off[/code]), text (in quotes when it has spaces), vectors as [code]x,y[/code] or [code]x,y,z[/code], and other types written as in GDScript, such as [code]Color(1, 0, 0)[/code]. Arguments with defaults can be left out. A lambda's argument types can't be seen, so a lambda gets numbers, [code]true[/code] and [code]false[/code], or text. What a command returns is shown. [code]help[/code] lists the commands, [code]clear[/code] empties the console, and [code]perf[/code] shows or hides [member DebugDraw.performance_overlay], and [code]profile[/code] records 10 seconds (or as many as given) and saves a report of where the time went to [code]user://profiles[/code]. Up and Down go through earlier commands, and Tab completes a command's name. While it's open, a captured or hidden mouse pointer is shown, and [Input] reports no keys or actions held, so typing doesn't move the game. The console is on in debug builds. In release exports it's off unless [code]console/enabled_in_release_builds[/code] is set, or the game sets [member enabled].

method.name: add_command
method.description: Adds a command, which runs [param callable] when [param name] is typed. [param description] says what it does in [code]help[/code]. A name can't have spaces. Adding a command with a name already used replaces it.

method.name: get_commands
method.description: Every command's name, sorted, including the built-in [code]clear[/code], [code]help[/code] and [code]perf[/code].

method.name: get_text
method.description: Everything in the console, a line each.

method.name: has_command
method.description: Whether there's a command called [param name].

method.name: run
method.description: Runs [param line] as if it were typed in, and returns what the command returned. Mistakes (an unknown command, missing arguments, a value of the wrong type) are written to the console, and return [code]null[/code].

method.name: write
method.description: Adds [param text] to the console without printing it to the log.

members.member: Whether the console can open. Commands added and [method run] work either way.
